shots.vo: Baby Krishna steals butter while Yashoda watches.
shots.prompt: inside a mud-walled village kitchen in Gokul at dawn, baby Krishna sits on the floor beside a tipped clay pot, his hands full of white butter, butter on his cheeks, while his mother Yashoda in a red cotton saree stands in the doorway, hands on hips, smiling, warm sunlight through a small window, clay pots and a churning rod

shots.vo: Vishnu rests on the serpent Shesha.
shots.prompt: Lord Vishnu reclining on a giant coiled white serpent Shesha whose five separate cobra heads with hoods spread wide rise above him like a canopy, divinely beautiful blue-skinned god in yellow dhoti with gold crown, one hand resting on his side, on a calm ocean under a starry sky; Goddess Lakshmi, a fair-skinned woman in a red saree, sitting small at his feet on the right, soft golden light, wide shot

Lord Hanuman flying through a night sky with an entire green forested mountain resting on his raised right palm high above his head, monkey god with a furry reddish face, long tail, gold crown and gold armlets, a golden mace held in his left hand, lightning clouds behind him, stars, wide shot

Lord Shiva sits cross-legged in deep meditation on a snow-covered ledge of Mount Kailash, a cobra around his neck, the crescent moon in his matted hair, a trident planted beside him, mist and first light over the Himalayan peaks

why.2: Vishnu and Lakshmi are merged into one body, with blue legs coming out of a red-saree woman holding a trident and a lotus. The serpent shows no hooded heads, only a coiled body.
why.3: The figure is a bearded human with no vanara features, so it doesn't read as Hanuman. The mountain is a mossy blob held against his back, not lifted on his palm, and he carries a ring-topped staff instead of a mace.
